All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Customer `fwod101-n1 Bench Customer` created (Individual contact, res.partner id 44) with City = `Benchville`. Verified by reopening the record: Name "fwod101-n1 Bench Customer", City "Benchville".

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Quotation `S00021` created for that customer with one order line: product `[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens`, quantity 3.00. Unit price the app filled in: **£295.00**. Untaxed amount computed: **£885.00** (TAX 20% £177.00, Total £1,062.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** Second line added: product `[E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors`, quantity 2.00, unit price £140.00 (line subtotal £280.00). New untaxed amount: **£1,165.00** (TAX 20% £233.00, Total £1,398.00). First line unchanged at Acoustic Bloc Screens qty 3.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE:** First line's quantity changed from 3 to 5 (line 1 subtotal £1,475.00; line 2 unchanged at £280.00). Untaxed amount afterwards: **£1,755.00** (TAX 20% £351.00, Total £2,106.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE:** Quotation confirmed via the header Confirm button. Order reference: **S00021**. Status shown: **"Sales Order"** (statusbar radio checked; header buttons changed to Create Invoice / Send by Email / Preview / Cancel). Untaxed amount unchanged at £1,755.00.

**Objective 6 — DONE:** Sales order cancelled via the header Cancel button plus the confirmation wizard. Status shown after cancelling: **"Cancelled"** (checked and disabled in the statusbar; the Cancel/Confirm buttons are gone, replaced by Preview and Set to Quotation). The record still exists — it was not deleted. Final read-only check in the Sales Orders list confirms S00021 / fwod101-n1 Bench Customer / £2,106.00 / **Cancelled**.

Note: during objective 3, an initial attempt at a second product ("Corner Desk Left Sit") priced at £0.00, so I switched that line to "Cabinet with Doors", which priced correctly at £140.00 — the final saved state has only the two intended lines.
